news.title: Dillon Brooks ejected from Suns' loss after flagrant foul 2 in third quarter
news.text: Phoenix Suns forward Dillon Brooks was ejected Friday night in a 127-120 loss to the Denver Nuggets for kicking guard Jamal Murray in the groin, an infraction that officials upgraded to a Flagrant 2 foul, which is an automatic ejection.

news.title: Murray scores 39 points, Braun adds 31 to lead Nuggets over the Suns 127-120 in NBA Cup

news.title: Nikola Jokic records 200th career triple-double in Nuggets' win over Pelicans
news.text: Denver's Nikola Jokic had 21 points, 13 rebounds and 10 assists for his 200th career triple-double Wednesday night as the Nuggets beat the Pelicans. He needs 10 more to supplant the retired Russell Westbrook as the NBA leader.

news.title: Nikola Jokic notches 200th career triple-double as the Nuggets down the Pelicans, 104-91
news.text: — Nikola Jokic had 21 points, 13 rebounds and 10 assists for his 200th career triple-double in the regular season, and the Denver Nuggets never trailed in a 104-91 victory over the winless New Orleans Pelicans on Wednesday night.
